subject: Welcome to Redwood — quick engineering walkthrough availability
messages:
From: noreply@redwood.ai
To: emma@catalyst.co
Date: 2028-05-22T09:12:45Z
Subject: Thanks for signing up — pick an engineer-friendly slot

Hi Emma,

Thanks for signing up for Redwood! We'd love to show you how Redwood Inference can help reduce your token costs and stabilize latency for inference in production. To make scheduling fast, pick a 30- or 45-minute slot with one of our engineers here: https://cal.redwood.ai/s/soojin-30m

What the walk-through covers (30 min):
- Quick architecture fit: where you'd put Redwood in your stack
- Latency and cost trade-offs we've seen for similar customers
- Live demo: model routing, caching, and rollout controls

If you'd like a longer session or separate infra deep-dive, choose the 45-minute option at the link.

Cheers,
The Redwood Team
